biggestGap: Recolour the .xp-hl achievement bullets from rgb(247,248,248) (18.73:1) to the secondary rgb(144,150,161) and promote .xp-blurb to rgb(247,248,248), so the brightest thing in each entry is the one-line role summary instead of the nine lines of supporting detail that currently outweigh the 24px company name.
motion: Real and correct. Frame 000 catches the section mid-reveal: eyebrow + 'The roles, in order.' at partial opacity and translated ~13 CSS px lower than their resting position; frame 001 (+130ms) has them at full brightness and final position; frames 002–005 are pixel-identical (003/004/005 are byte-identical, 179984 bytes each), so the reveal completes inside ~260ms of out-expo easing and never re-fires. Measured before entry: .reveal elements sit at transform matrix(1,0,0,1,0,18) / opacity 0, transition-property 'opacity, transform' only, 0.62s, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), stagger 0s / 0.07s / 0.14s = 70ms. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the items load already .is-in with transform none, opacity 1, duration 1e-05s. Nothing animates that is not transform or opacity; no animation-name anywhere in the section. This is the strongest part of the piece and clears SPEC 1.3 outright.

evidence: Opened with the Read tool: captures/critic-r1/experience/experience-element.png (mid-reveal, entries 2–3 still faded), experience-viewport-000.png and -001.png (these are mis-anchored — shot.mjs measures the boundingBox after scrolling, so it treats the viewport-relative y as a document offset and screenshots scroll 613 and 1465, i.e. the Track Record and Selected Work sections, not #experience), and experience-motion-000 through -003.png. Because the harness viewport shots were wrong I re-captured the section myself at 393x852, DPR 3, 4x CPU throttle via harness/_critic_r1.mjs: captures/critic-r1/own/vp-0.png, vp-1.png and element-revealed.png (full section, all three entries revealed) — all opened and looked at. Numbers quoted come from page.evaluate probes in harness/_critic_r1.mjs, _critic_r1b.mjs and _critic_r1c.mjs (computed styles, bounding boxes, ::before geometry, WCAG contrast against the measured rgb(8,9,10) body background, and a font-size/weight histogram: 13px/590 x7, 24px/590 x3, 17px/510 x3, 17px/400 x9, 13px/510 x11). Passes worth recording: document.scrollWidth = 393 (no overflow), measure 35 characters at 329px on both .xp-blurb and the bullets (32–40 band), page gutter x = 20px, section padding-bottom 80px (72–96 band), exactly one accent hue rgb(124,140,255) used on exactly one element in the section, hairlines at rgba(255,255,255,0.075), and zero interactive elements in the section so there are no tap targets to fail.
